headline: Launcher 0.6.0 opens up model and texture mods
summary: OpenRAC released launcher 0.6.0 with model and texture replacement packs, following updates for cutscenes, wrench throwing, automatic updates and Linux ARM64. Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 88.30% to 92.32%. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Going Commando added shared level and core-library routines, while OpenRAC#12 reports a Fedora Wayland startup crash in launcher 0.5.0.
